description: This is a Python source file implementing legacy embedding transformation logic for Cohere's v1 API within a larger language model framework. It defines classes and methods for handling request transformation, response parsing, and usage calculation specific to Cohere embeddings.

classes.name: CohereEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Class encapsulating configuration and transformation logic for Cohere embedding requests and responses, including parameter mapping, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self)
methods.description: Returns list of supported OpenAI parameter names, currently only 'encoding_format'.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style parameters to Cohere-specific parameters, specifically translating 'encoding_format' to 'embedding_types'.

methods.name: bool _is_v3_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if a given model string indicates a v3 model based on the presence of '3'.

methods.name: CohereEmbeddingRequestWithModel _transform_request( self, model: str, input: List[str], inference_params: dict )
methods.description: Transforms input texts into a CohereEmbeddingRequestWithModel, handling base64-encoded inputs as images or texts.

methods.name: Usage _calculate_usage(self, input: List[str], encoding: Any, meta: dict)
methods.description: Calculates and returns token usage information based on input texts, image tokens, and metadata.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _transform_response( self, response: httpx.Response, api_key: Optional[str], logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, data: Union[dict, CohereEmbeddingRequest], model_response: EmbeddingResponse, model: str, encoding: Any, input: list, )
methods.description: Parses the HTTP response from Cohere, logs details, and structures embeddings data into a consistent format for further use.
